footnotes: The sequences of MpVT were obtained from N-terminal sequence. The red letters indicate that the amino acid had changed; the blue letters indicate an added amino acid; %H, hydrophobic residues; H, hydrophobicity; μH, hydrophobic moment; molecular weight of peptides observed by mass spectrophotometry from Genic bio Inc. (Shanghai, China). The charge, hydrophobicity, and hydrophobic moment were calculated using Heliquest (https://heliquest.ipmc.cnrs.fr/cgi-bin/ComputParams.py, accessed on 25 June 2021).
